title: Pink Halloween Trick or Treat Porch Essentials
intro: The trick or treat kit for a porch that goes pink. A pink pumpkin bucket that lights up, a ceramic ghost candy bowl with a bow, pink pumpkin string lights for the railing, a dozen little faux pumpkins for the steps and a stack of pink ghost treat bags for the kids who show up after the candy runs low. Sweet instead of scary, set up in twenty minutes, and every trick or treater under five will tell you it is the best house on the street. That is the review that counts.

items.name: Pink bow ghost ceramic candy bowl
Pink ghost cellophane treat bags, 100 pack
